Quiz: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace Story Quiz
Question: How many figures did Nebuchadnezzar see walking in the fire?
Explanation: The king was astonished: he had cast in three bound men, but he saw four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire.
